purpose: Define a generic provenance sidecar contract for Tokenoskobi intelligence objects so lineage, source, model and validation context are traceable without bloating staging/hot-path payloads.
scope_rule: General OS-level contract. News is only the first consumer. No product-specific code or runtime mutation.

core_principles.staging_compact: Staging/context payloads carry correlation_id only for lineage pointer.
core_principles.sidecar_detail: Heavy provenance metadata lives in sidecar/map keyed by correlation_id.
core_principles.hot_path_safety: Hot Path reads compact ready state only and must not parse heavy sidecar detail.
core_principles.heavy_path_access: Heavy Path may lookup sidecar by correlation_id under budget, TTL and authorization constraints.
core_principles.raw_traceability: Every sidecar entry must preserve enough trace to connect interpreted context back to raw/source/evidence references.
core_principles.no_authority: Provenance sidecar is trace context, not decision, trade, veto or canonical authority.

correlation_id_contract.format_rule: Deterministic or collision-resistant opaque id. Must not encode secret, key, wallet credential or private source payload.
correlation_id_contract.uniqueness_scope: Unique within active provenance namespace and retained with archive lineage after TTL/archive move.

origin_rules.ai_output_rule: AI/model output must be marked RAW_CONTEXT_ONLY or STAGING_CONTEXT unless Strict Evidence validates it later.
origin_rules.training_output_rule: Training Camp outputs are RAW_CONTEXT_ONLY by default and cannot become canonical directly.
origin_rules.human_override_rule: Commander override may be referenced but must not erase original provenance lineage.
origin_rules.no_self_truth_rule: A model or engine may not treat its own prior output as ground truth without independent evidence lineage.

sidecar_bloat_controls.max_payload_rule: Sidecar stores compact provenance metadata and references; large bodies must be file/object referenced by hash.

forbidden: Do not embed heavy provenance metadata inside staging objects.
Do not allow sidecar metadata to become final decision authority.
Do not store secrets, private keys or API tokens in provenance sidecar.
Do not treat AI/training output as canonical truth.
Do not require Hot Path to lookup full sidecar.
Do not create product-specific News-only provenance code in ERA38.
